definition: One of the seven awakening factors, named here in its specific form.
notes: Inherit the `passaddhi` headword, whose default is `relaxation` and which scopes `tranquility` to prose needing a more state-like English noun. The record read `tranquility awakening factor` until 2026-09-13, contradicting that default and both translation surfaces that list the seven factors.

example_phrases.notes: The running-text form in SN 46.1, where all seven factors are named in the same sentence shape.
